title: Access control list (ACL) overview: what permissions can I grant?
note: Amendment 2, round 5 (batch F12, q-saa-1-1-s05-mc rationale fix): fetched from docs.aws.amazon.com. Confirms the READ permission when granted on a bucket allows the grantee to list the objects (maps to s3:ListBucket, s3:ListBucketVersions, s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads) but not to read them; reading an object's data requires s3:GetObject, which is granted by READ on the object itself, not on the bucket.
